verdict.rationale: Skills for Real Engineers is a bundle of markdown SKILL.md files that agents invoke through slash commands, installed via CLI or plugin marketplaces. It has no UI and no API, so API-versus-UI parity is a category error for this kind of product. The CLI install path does not change that, since there is no graphical surface to match.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
